mapper.select: select id, title, date, repeat_yearly, note, visibility from anniversary where visibility = 'PUBLIC' order by date, id
select id, title, date, repeat_yearly, note, visibility from anniversary order by date, id
mapper.insert: insert into anniversary (title, date, repeat_yearly, note, visibility) values (#{title}, #{date}, #{repeatYearly}, #{note}, #{visibility})
mapper.update: update anniversary set title = #{title}, date = #{date}, repeat_yearly = #{repeatYearly}, note = #{note}, visibility = #{visibility} where id = #{id}
